2026-11-13-gaza-1.statement: The Gaza Ministry of Health reports that 1,800 or more Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect.
2026-11-13-gaza-1.resolution: Yes if a Gaza Health Ministry figure, as reported by Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP or OCHA, published on or before 2027-01-31, gives a post-ceasefire death toll of at least 1,800.

2026-11-13-lebanon-1.statement: Israel carries out an air strike on Beirut's southern suburbs (Dahiyeh).
2026-11-13-lebanon-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera or L'Orient Today report an Israeli air or drone strike hitting Beirut's southern suburbs between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-iran-1.statement: The United States and/or Israel strike targets on the Iranian mainland away from the Hormuz coast and islands (e.g. Tehran, Isfahan, Natanz, Fordow, or other inland sites).
2026-11-13-iran-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report a US or Israeli strike on a site in an inland Iranian province (not Hormozgan, Bushehr coast or the Gulf islands) between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-iran-2.statement: The United States and Iran publicly announce an agreement or framework to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping.
2026-11-13-iran-2.resolution: Yes if both governments, or the mediating state (Qatar/Oman) with both sides confirming, announce an agreed arrangement for reopening Hormuz, as reported by Reuters or AP, by 2027-01-31.

2026-11-13-yemen-1.statement: Yemeni government forces open a land route into Taiz city, breaking the Houthi siege.
2026-11-13-yemen-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera or OCHA report that government forces have reopened a road into Taiz city allowing civilian or aid traffic, by 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-israel-1.statement: A new Israeli government headed by Gadi Eisenkot wins a Knesset confidence vote and is sworn in.
2026-11-13-israel-1.resolution: Yes if Times of Israel, Haaretz, Reuters or AP report that the Knesset approved a government with Eisenkot as prime minister by 2027-01-15.

2026-11-13-iraq-1.statement: A drone or rocket attack targets the US Embassy in Baghdad or the US consulate in Erbil.
2026-11-13-iraq-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, Shafaq News or Rudaw report a drone or rocket attack aimed at (including intercepted over) the US Embassy in Baghdad or the US consulate in Erbil between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-saudi-arabia-1.statement: A single Houthi missile or drone attack on Saudi territory kills five or more people.
2026-11-13-saudi-arabia-1.resolution: Yes if Saudi authorities, Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report at least five deaths from one Houthi attack (including interception debris) on Saudi territory between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-jordan-1.statement: Another attack inside Jordan that authorities describe as terrorist kills at least one person.
2026-11-13-jordan-1.resolution: Yes if Jordanian authorities (Public Security Directorate/Petra), as reported by Reuters, AP, The National or Asharq Al-Awsat, attribute a fatal attack on Jordanian territory to terrorism between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-libya-1.statement: Armed clashes between rival groups in Zawiya or Surman kill three or more people in a single episode.
2026-11-13-libya-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, Libya Observer, Libya Security Monitor or UNSMIL report at least three deaths from one episode of armed clashes in Zawiya or Surman between 2026-11-12 and 2027-02-12.

2026-11-13-ukraine-1.statement: Russian forces take full control of the town of Kostiantynivka (Donetsk Oblast).
2026-11-13-ukraine-1.resolution: Yes if DeepState's map or ISW's assessment shows the whole built-up area of Kostiantynivka under Russian control (a Russian MoD claim alone does not count).

2026-11-13-russia-1.statement: Russia and Ukraine carry out a prisoner exchange in which each side releases at least 500 prisoners of war (in one swap or in stages announced as part of the Abu Dhabi deal).
2026-11-13-russia-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or the Kyiv Independent reports that at least 500 POWs per side have been exchanged under the agreement by that date, per official Ukrainian or Russian statements.

2026-11-13-moldova-1.statement: A Russian drone or missile, or identifiable wreckage of one, falls on Moldovan territory (crash or impact, not only an overflight).
2026-11-13-moldova-1.resolution: Yes if Moldova's Defence Ministry or police report a crash, impact or recovered wreckage of a Russian drone or missile on Moldovan territory, as reported by Reuters, AP or Moldovan official channels.

2026-11-13-georgia-1.statement: Georgia's Constitutional Court rules to ban (declare unconstitutional) at least one of the five opposition parties named in the Georgian Dream petition.
2026-11-13-georgia-1.resolution: Yes if Civil.ge, Georgia Today, JAMnews or Reuters reports a Constitutional Court ruling banning at least one of UNM, Coalition for Change, Strong Georgia/Lelo, the Federalists or Gakharia for Georgia by that date.

2026-11-13-mali-1.statement: JNIM attacks a fuel tanker convoy anywhere in Mali in an incident that reportedly kills ten or more people (drivers, escorts or civilians).
2026-11-13-mali-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, RFI or ACLED reports a single JNIM attack on a fuel convoy in Mali on or before 31 Jan 2027 with a reported toll of at least ten dead.

2026-11-13-sudan-1.statement: The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied forces retake the Sali military base in Blue Nile from the RSF–SPLM-N alliance.
2026-11-13-sudan-1.resolution: Yes if Sudan Tribune, Dabanga, Sudans Post, Reuters or AP reports, on or before 12 Feb 2027, that SAF or allied forces have regained control of Sali (an SAF claim corroborated by footage or a second independent source counts).

2026-11-13-chad-1.statement: The Chadian army takes control of the town of Miski in Tibesti from the Miski Self-Defence Committee, by force or under a negotiated handover.
2026-11-13-chad-1.resolution: Yes if AFP, Reuters, RFI or Crisis Group reports on or before 12 Feb 2027 that Chadian state forces control Miski town.

2026-11-13-nigeria-1.statement: ISWAP or Boko Haram fighters attack a military base or forward position in Borno or Yobe in a single attack that reportedly kills ten or more Nigerian soldiers.
2026-11-13-nigeria-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, AFP, HumAngle, Premium Times or Daily Trust reports, on or before 12 Feb 2027, a single attack in Borno or Yobe in which at least ten soldiers were killed (military, security-source or credible local tolls count).

2026-11-13-north-korea-1.statement: North Korea launches at least one ballistic missile that South Korea's JCS publicly reports.
2026-11-13-north-korea-1.resolution: Yes if the JCS (as reported by Yonhap, Reuters or AP) announces at least one North Korean ballistic missile launch between 2026-11-12 and 2026-12-31. Cruise-missile or artillery-only launches do not count.

2026-11-13-myanmar-1.statement: The Arakan Army takes full control of Sittwe, the Rakhine State capital, with junta forces withdrawn or defeated.
2026-11-13-myanmar-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, The Irrawaddy or DVB report by 2027-02-12 that the AA controls Sittwe town and the regime's regional command there has fallen or withdrawn. AA claims alone do not count.

2026-11-13-pakistan-1.statement: Pakistan carries out at least one airstrike or drone strike inside Afghan territory.
2026-11-13-pakistan-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or Al Jazeera report by 2027-02-12 a Pakistani air or drone strike on Afghan territory, confirmed by Pakistan or reported by the Taliban government. Cross-border artillery or small-arms fire alone does not count.

2026-11-13-taiwan-1.statement: The PLA Eastern Theater Command announces a named large-scale military exercise around Taiwan (in the style of Strait Thunder or Justice Mission).
2026-11-13-taiwan-1.resolution: Yes if, by 2027-02-12, the PLA Eastern Theater Command or Chinese state media publicly announce a drill around Taiwan under a specific exercise name, as reported by Reuters, AP or Taiwan's MND. Unannounced surges and routine 'joint combat readiness patrols' do not count.

2026-11-13-philippines-1.statement: China Coast Guard vessels fire water cannon at a Philippine government vessel (PCG, BFAR or Navy) in the South China Sea.
2026-11-13-philippines-1.resolution: Yes if, by 2027-02-12, the PCG, the AFP or the Philippine NSC report a CCG water-cannon use against a Philippine government vessel, as carried by Reuters, AP or Philippine national media.

2026-11-13-south-korea-1.statement: South Korean troops fire warning shots at North Korean soldiers crossing the Military Demarcation Line.
2026-11-13-south-korea-1.resolution: Yes if the JCS, as reported by Yonhap, Korea JoongAng Daily, Reuters or AP, confirms at least one new warning-shot incident against North Korean troops crossing the MDL between 2026-11-12 and 2027-01-31.

2026-11-13-venezuela-1.statement: Venezuela's interim government or the CNE officially announces a specific date for a presidential election.
2026-11-13-venezuela-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP or EFE report that the Rodriguez government or the National Electoral Council has formally set a calendar date for a presidential election by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-colombia-1.statement: A single attack by an armed group in Colombia kills five or more soldiers and/or police officers.
2026-11-13-colombia-1.resolution: Yes if Reuters, AP, EFE or Colombian national media (El Tiempo, El Espectador) report one incident (one attack or ambush on one day) in which at least five members of the security forces were killed by an armed group, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-haiti-1.statement: 400 Mawozo leader Wilson Joseph ('Lanmo Sanjou') is killed or taken into custody.
2026-11-13-haiti-1.resolution: Yes if Haitian authorities, the Salvadoran government or the GSF confirm Joseph's death, capture or surrender, as reported by AP, Reuters, the Miami Herald or the Haitian Times, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-haiti-2.statement: Haitian or Salvadoran authorities confirm the fate (found alive or confirmed dead) of the four Salvadoran aviation technicians missing since 18 October.
2026-11-13-haiti-2.resolution: Yes if the Salvadoran or Haitian government officially states that the four technicians have been recovered alive or that their deaths are confirmed (identified remains included), as reported by AP, Reuters or Al Jazeera, by 31 January 2027.

2026-11-13-cuba-1.statement: Cuba's national electric system (SEN) suffers a total nationwide disconnection (complete grid collapse).
2026-11-13-cuba-1.resolution: Yes if the Ministry of Energy and Mines or the UNE announces a total disconnection of the SEN, as reported by EFE, Reuters, AP or 14ymedio, by 12 February 2027. Partial or regional collapses do not count.

2026-11-13-ecuador-1.statement: President Noboa decrees a fifth curfew of 2026–27 covering at least one coastal province (Guayas, Manabi, Los Rios, El Oro or Esmeraldas).
2026-11-13-ecuador-1.resolution: Yes if an executive decree imposing a new night-time curfew in at least one of these provinces takes effect after 12 November 2026, as reported by Primicias, El Universo, EFE or Reuters, by 12 February 2027.

2026-11-13-peru-1.statement: Public transport unions in Lima/Callao carry out a strike (paro) against extortion in which a majority of formal bus companies suspend service for at least one day.
2026-11-13-peru-1.resolution: Yes if Peruvian national media (El Comercio, La Republica, RPP, Infobae Peru) or Reuters/AP report a transport strike in Lima/Callao described as widespread or as paralysing most routes, held after 12 November 2026 and by 12 February 2027.
